Examples

Six themes. Same Markdown.

Each demo below is a real Tangly project — its own docs.json + MDX, rendered by the same CLI you'd run locally. Pick a register, swap a one-line theme value.

Tang
default

Cipher

Encrypt anything in three lines of code. — Mintlify-Mint inspired sidebar, on-page TOC, monospace headings.

tangly init --theme tangOpen →
Pith
editorial

On Craft

A handbook of small ideas about making things. — Serif headings, cream surface, generous measure.

tangly init --theme pithOpen →
Pip
minimal

Sprig

A tiny CLI for tagging your shell history. — No sidebar. Single-column reading mode.

tangly init --theme pipOpen →
Readable
book-like

The Long Wait

A short novel in three chapters. — Narrow column, large body type, drop caps.

tangly init --theme readableOpen →
Geist
developer

Halo

Ship apps to the edge in 30 seconds. — Vercel/Linear register. Ink ground, thin rules, dense type scale.

tangly init --theme geistOpen →
Starter
scaffold

Tangly Starter

Three sections, three pages, no opinions. The fastest way to start typing.

tangly init --theme starterOpen →
